## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill positioning-messaging-framework
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/positioning-messaging-framework/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/positioning-messaging-framework/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
